## Retraction Note: BMC Plant Biol 19, 432 (2019) https://doi.org/10.1186/s12870-019-2026-1.

The Editor has retracted this article after concerns were raised about some of the data reported. Specifically, two images appear to have been duplicated in Fig. 7a and e, respectively. The authors were not able to provide raw data following a request by the Editor. The Editor there­ fore no longer has confidence in the reliability of the results and conclusions presented in this article.
